description: The plot illustrates how the normalized average gate value varies with the number of experts for several task categories. The x-axis is labeled “Experts” and uses a logarithmic scale with tick labels at 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, and 64 (range 1–64). The y-axis is labeled “Normalized Average Gate Value” on a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.20 with regularly spaced tick labels every 0.05. Six solid lines are shown with shaded bands around each line: Intent (red), Summary (blue), Law (orange), Translation (purple), Math (gray), and Code (green); all lines decrease as experts increase. Translation (purple) starts highest at about 0.17 at 1 expert, drops to roughly 0.09 at 2, about 0.05 at 4, around 0.03 at 8, about 0.02 at 16, near 0.01 at 32, and approaches ~0.00 by 64. Summary (blue) begins near ~0.075 at 1, declines to ~0.055 at 2, ~0.040 at 4, ~0.030 at 8, ~0.020 at 16, ~0.012 at 32, and ~0.004 at 64. Code (green) starts around ~0.078 at 1, decreases to ~0.055 at 2, ~0.042 at 4, ~0.028 at 8, ~0.018 at 16, ~0.012 at 32, and ~0.006 at 64. Law (orange) begins near ~0.065 at 1, falls to ~0.048 at 2, ~0.036 at 4, ~0.027 at 8, ~0.019 at 16, ~0.013 at 32, and ~0.006 at 64. Intent (red) starts around ~0.060 at 1, drops to ~0.045 at 2, ~0.034 at 4, ~0.026 at 8, ~0.018 at 16, ~0.013 at 32, and ~0.005 at 64. Math (gray) begins lowest at roughly ~0.050 at 1, decreases to ~0.038 at 2, ~0.030 at 4, ~0.024 at 8, ~0.018 at 16, ~0.014 at 32, and ~0.007 at 64. A horizontal dashed gray reference line is also drawn across the plot at approximately y = 0.015.
